invariant: The artifact author must not be able to suppress prior reviewer-relevant memory from R2/R3 merely by rewording the artifact under review.
attack_family: R1 rewords an equivalent artifact so non-authoritative prior memory loses lexical overlap and is omitted from R2/R3 retrieval
raising minimum_overlap amplifies proposer control because artifact content currently participates directly in the admission query
notes: The current ContextCompiler concatenates request.user_input and artifact.content for retrieval query construction.
The current GovernedLexicalRetriever uses lexical overlap as an admission gate for non-authoritative records.
Freeze a production-path regression proving artifact rewording cannot alter the admitted review-memory set before changing retrieval construction.
